It lists local nx CLI commands (generate, affected, graph, build, reset, migrate) at details.md:368-387 that operate on the user's own workspace; nx migrate latest updates dependency versions in package.json, which the user would normally review. No credential use or network calls are instructed beyond what nx itself does.

The Nx Cloud token in the remote-caching example is a placeholder ('your-nx-cloud-token'); the documented practice of putting the token in nx.json should be replaced by an environment variable in real repos.
